laboratory.environment: Other agents were compiling; timing failures do not establish an isolated performance regression.

full_voice_acceptance.reason: The published live Laboratory has only a greeting scenario. Its native voice action harness is not exposed as a published recorded-audio scenario. A rendered release window was opened, but its accessibility tree exposed only the window frame, so the attempted external control did not establish rendered voice acceptance.
full_voice_acceptance.recommendation: Expose the existing recorded-audio/native-action workflow as an explicit opt-in Laboratory scenario in a future release.

moonshine_dictation_controls.scope: Actual pinned Tiny model through Import/Stop/transcribe/draft edits/Cancel; no messages created

native_authenticated_voice.input: verified synthetic PCM through acoustic wake gate and native UI controls; no room capture
verified: spoken reply queued and playback finished
follow-up accepted without another wake phrase
background speech does not cause another delivery
native_authenticated_voice.scope: Native component/action harness built from current working tree; this is not the published executable or a personal-voice accuracy test.

stop_during_playback.verified: Capture and automatic resumption remain off after playback finishes.

shared_features: cancellation retains worker ownership until work ends
silence filtering before inference and for silent long-recording segments
implementation.ui: Shared speech settings provide model selection, download/import and selected-model status.
implementation.publication: Moonshine integration requires a new application build.

verified: reopening with retained assets and unloaded weights

credentials.renewal: Published application normal locked-vault flow; one retained Laboratory greeting in the original account data. No copied refresh token was used.
credentials.fixtures: Disposable data; encrypted access-only credentials; protected password files; no credential values in reports.

limitations: The published live Laboratory scenario covers a greeting and normal conversation component state. It does not automate the complete wake/listening flow. Native action-harness voice evidence will be reported separately.
Moonshine integration is newer than the published executable and needs a new build.
Supported local architectures run in Rust. Importing arbitrary weights does not implement an unsupported architecture. Compatible transcription endpoints remain a dictation option.
Raw recognition is imperfect. Preserve original strict references and the accepted Phonon pears/pairs failures in recorded/performance.rs. Dictation review is suitable for exact words and quantities.

Optional local semantic routing accuracy remains deferred. Prior Laya abstentions and Qwen routing/admission failures do not justify enabling ambient admission; default Fiote/provider fallback remains the supported path.
Synthetic audio does not establish personal-voice or room-microphone recognition accuracy; the owner retained that optional check.

The real-account source voice test had a substantial first spoken-response cold start under concurrent compilation: first saved reply at 27.6 s, first output queued at 68.7 s. This run does not establish isolated latency; retaining timings is preferable to claiming instant voice assistance.
outcome: Executed Fiote checks passed; published full voice acceptance remains unverified.

accepted_asr_limitation.decision: Keep the model and original quality assertions; exact details can use Dictate, review/edit, Send.
accepted_asr_limitation.status: Accepted historical model limitation; not rerun or rewritten in this implementation.
